# Fold Electronics

Certified refurbished consumer electronics. Grade A, B, and C units. B2C and B2B.

## Commerce

- [SHOP.md](/shop.md): Store identity, logistics, and commerce context for AI agents.
- [CATALOG.md](/catalog.md): Full inventory with grade, condition notes, specifications, and pricing for 1,800 or more units, queryable by category, grade, price, and stock.
- [POLICIES.md](/policies.md): Complete warranty, return, B2B, and shipping policies.
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Instructions for how AI agents should interact with this store, including permitted actions and checkout guidance.
- [llms.txt](/llms.txt): Full index of all AI-readable files on this store.
